narrative.overview: Kontier RI is a room where two kinds of hands work one artifact. The report is the shared surface, so the design keeps the work in the middle and pushes the apparatus to the edges: a navy rail for where you are, a light canvas for what is true, one agent column for what is proposed. The system is quiet by construction and precise by preference: chrome is hairlines and flat fields, numbers are the loudest thing on screen, and the only saturated ink means agency. Depth is tonal — a white card on a grey-blue canvas with a soft two-layer shadow, or a flat colour field with no border at all.
keyCharacteristics: One family (DM Sans) with tabular numerals; mono only for SQL and formulas.
One saturated accent, reserved for agency and primary action.
Flat colour fields for metrics; hairline-and-shadow cards for everything else.
A 12-column, 64px-row canvas on a 24px dot field.
Status colour is semantic only: ok, warn, danger.

rules.name: The One Agency Ink Rule
rules.body: Indigo means an agent acted or a human must act. It never decorates, and status colour never means agency.

rules.name: The Measured Contrast Rule
rules.body: Every small-text token clears 4.5:1 against white, the canvas, the sunken surface and all three metric fields. Ink is darkened to reach the ratio; opacity is never stacked on muted text.

rules.name: The Semantic Series Rule
rules.body: Chart series use the indigo ramp. A series turns danger only when the measure itself means loss.

rules.name: The Two-Line Title Rule
rules.body: Tile titles wrap to two lines rather than truncating; the exact spec summary lives in the header's hover title.

rules.name: The One Elevation Device Rule
rules.body: A surface declares depth once: hairline plus card shadow, or flat colour field. Never a border under a heavy shadow, never a shadow on a tinted field.

dos: Do reserve indigo for agency and primary action, and keep status colour semantic.
Do apply KPI tints by position in the band (mint, lavender, plain, peach).
Do give every KPI a delta line so value and delta baselines align across the row.
Do derive tile sub-lines, chips and lineage from real state, and label synthetic demo data.
Do keep agent objects reviewable in place: the tile carries the proposal, the panel carries the queue.
donts: Don't put a border under a heavy shadow, or any shadow on a tinted metric field.
Don't introduce a second type family.
Don't fill the active page tab; the underline is the active state.
Don't shrink the 12-column editor onto a phone — stack it and disable spatial editing.
Don't render agent presence from timers, animation or persona.
